page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with a dedication heading at top and verse below; a small stamp/handwritten fragment at the right edge is not transcribed. Bottom centre: signature-like "* 3" and catchword "Sceptra" at right.

main_text.head: Clarissimo, Consultissimo VIRO, PAULO VOET, Juris in illustri Academiâ Ultrajectinâ Professori ordinario, & Camerae Vianensis Senatori, Cùm erudite STATUTORUM Jura illustrasset.
main_text.p: SCribite vos, alii, veterum dictamina legum, Et toties scriptum pandite juris opus; Quae Paulus responsa dabat, quae Scævola, Celsus, Ac Labeo, Latii dogmata mille fori.
Si placeat Romana Themis, placet altera Belgis, Nec proprium Romae condere jura fuit.
Sunt non pauca, novis quae sanxit serior aetas Legibus, aut ratio congrua motve probat.

page.notes: The initial S is a large woodcut historiated initial, transcribed as "S" joined to "Cribite". Left margin of the verse has a catchword-like word "Quae" underlined. Stamps and handwriting at the right edge and bottom right ("ve", "Sc", "201") are not transcribed. The last line of the verse reads "bat," in the scan, partly obscured; read as "probat" with the second line's word "motve" as printed in the scan [?].
